name: Gen 1 Kaindof
description: Gen 1 kind of Kaizo-style overhaul: trainers run themed parties of six with levels scaled by class tier (player avg + 1-5 regular, 5-10 Gym Leaders, 10-20 Elite Four), tiered DVs, progress-scaled Stat EXP, competitive movesets, and a competitive AI that exploits weaknesses; wild encounter pools widen to keep the player competitive.
